Traveler.bonusSkirk2.label: Elemental Mastery bonus
Traveler.bonusSkirk2.reason: A small Elemental Mastery bonus whose condition the planner cannot confirm for this Traveler; it can be switched on here.

burstFrostglow.label: Frostglow, eight stacks
burstFrostglow.reason: How many Frostglow stacks the Burst's Ice Javelin uses depends on what happened before it; the count scales all its hits alike.

c2Crystal.label: Constellation 2 Elemental Mastery
c2Crystal.reason: A Constellation 2 Elemental Mastery bonus that needs an ice crystal effect first.

a1ScStar.label: Polestar star bonus
a1ScStar.reason: A flat bonus and a Cryo infusion for Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks inside the Polestar field that need the star, which the planner cannot confirm. The infusion is counted for the Stellar-Conduct team when it is switched on here and it was checked once with it on against Genshin Optimizer; the flat bonus is not counted.

c2ActiveStellar.label: Constellation 2 with a Stellar reaction active
c2ActiveStellar.reason: Part of a Constellation 2 Elemental Mastery bonus for the active character that needs a Stellar reaction the party has set up, which depends on the team. No swap of the comparison can show it: it adds Elemental Mastery, which moves damage only through a reaction, and no case of the character's has one.

Traveler.lockedPassive.label: The Traveler's locked passive
Traveler.lockedPassive.reason: A passive of the Traveler's whose bonuses depend on the party's elements; the planner cannot tell whether it is on, so it is left for the player to switch on. It was checked once with it and its other switches on against Genshin Optimizer and agreed; no case commits it.
